# HARD-51 and Anicca iOS: fail-to-pass plus regression preservation

Audited 51 official task configs, all unique images and 3000-second agent/verifier budgets. Six negative metadata controls rejected. No native score. Actual Swift isolated UserDefaults memory recovery: four duplicate-key crashes before, all four pass after, five previously passing cases remain passing. PR #963. No real user data, Xcode/device or release claim. Native #758.

[Research evidence](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-ops/pull/759) · [iOS patch](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-products/pull/963)

Sources: [SWE-bench Pro V2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24206), [official harness](https://github.com/scaleapi/SWE-bench_Pro-os).
